summary.text: David Stumbo is the Republican nominee. He is in his fourth term as solicitor (district attorney) for the 8th Judicial Circuit, covering four Upstate counties, and previously worked in the Attorney General's office prosecuting internet crimes against children. He centers his campaign on his prosecution experience, and proposes regional attorney general's offices around the state.

paragraphs.text: Law degree from the University of South Carolina School of Law and a bachelor's degree from Toccoa Falls College.

Served in the South Carolina Attorney General's Office, prosecuting internet crimes against children cases and supervising the state grand jury; earlier an assistant solicitor in the 11th Judicial Circuit.
Elected solicitor of the 8th Judicial Circuit; now serving a fourth term.
